characters.description: When Aoi was seven years old, he wandered into the Momochi House and was chosen as the Omamori-sama. He transforms into Nue to perform his duties, but it seems this role was meant for Himari. When he transforms into Nue, he becomes an ayakashi the ears of a cat, the wings of a bird, and the tail of a fox. As the Omamori-sama, the nue protects Momochi House and eliminates demons who make their way in from the spiritual realm.
A 16-year-old orphan who, according to a certain will, has inherited Momochi House. As rightful owner, she has the ability to expel beings from the house.
One of Omamori-sama's shikigami. He is a water serpent.
One of omamori-sama's shikigami. He is an orangutan.

A childhood friend of Aoi who still has some fragments of his memories with him. He is the descendant of a family that had the power to control the Kuda-gitsune, a fox-like spirit, although he demonstrated that he did not inherit this ability, he still has some connection with the spirit world. (Source: Wikipedia)

Ruriko is a young woman who works as a beer vendor in the ballpark. She tries hard to engage with her customers, unlike her normally shy personality. ~!Later in the story it is implied she has developed a crush on Murata.!~
A 30-year old salaryman who often comes alone to the stadium. Ruriko often flirts with him and he always buys beer from her. ~!He becomes her first regular customer.!~

Natsuno is a college student working part-time as a bento shop cashier at the stadium. She has a crush on Murata, who she calls her "prince". She is distinguished by her long wavy hair, covered on top by a bandana.
Yuki is Kojiro's devoted wife who always comes to the stadium to watch his games and cheer him on.

Kohinata is the most experienced beer vendor working in the stadium. She is an office lady who has also been working part-time at the stadium for 10 years. She is distinguished by her long black hair, mole under her mouth and her sizable bust.
__Height:__ 172 cm __Position:__ Catcher
__Height:__ 167 cm __Position:__ Second Base
__Height:__ 185 cm __Position:__ Pitcher
__Height:__ 181 cm __Position:__ Shortstop
__Height:__ 164 cm __Position:__ Catcher

Mao is the main character of the eponymous story Mao. Throughout his long life, Mao has remained mature, reserved and somewhat aloof. He tends to dwell on his past and what he can't remember, which drives his obsessive search for the Byōki who cursed him. Mao favors onmyōdō exorcism and healing techniques, and avoids curse techniques. When in his Byōki form, Mao is outside the bounds of the Chinese elemental cycle, allowing him to attack at will without the threat of being exorcised.

Nanoka Kiba is the narrator and heroine of the story Mao. Outspoken, determined and brave, Nanoka is extremely curious about the circumstances of her and Mao's curse, leading her to research history with her classmate, Shiraha, when she returns home from the Taisho era. Despite her being a natural fighter, Nanoka is afraid to engage in conflict. She believes herself to be too weak to win against most opponents, but with her excursions with Mao, is growing more confident in her abilities.
Otoya is a kid serving the protagonist Mao. He’s a Shikigami, the result of Mao infusing his spiritual power onto a doll.

Hyakka is a former classmate of [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/138866/Mao) from 900 years ago. He was an apprentice 900 years ago, then worked in a circus, but he now travels with Mao and [Nanoka](https://anilist.co/character/138867/Kiba-Nanoka).

Kamon, also known as Kuchinawa, is a former senior disciple from 900 years ago. Following the Great Kanto Earthquake, he was serving Tanehiko who captured and murdered women in his mansion, by getting rid of their corpses. Just as he reunites with Mao who came to rescue Tanehiko's last victim Tenko, he was hired by his father to kill him as he was removed from power of the mansion due to his murders and does so by making his heart squeeze out. He and Mao then recognize each other and have a conversation about what happened 900 years ago although Kamon didn't know much detail.

Mizuki Ashiya, who is Japanese, but moved to America when she was young, is the heroine of the story. She spontaneously moved from California to Japan and enrolled into an all boys school (Osaka Gakuen) because her idol, Sano Izumi, who’s a top high jumper and the same age as her, attends the school. To look like a boy, she keeps her hair short and ruffled and wears a tight demin vest to hide her boobs. In many ways, it’s good that she has a pretty flat chest, but she wants more cleavage. She’s a very fast runner (due to her mother’s athleticism), but is very clumsy at times (due to her father’s clumsiness). Mizuki loves all kinds of food, especially sweet things, which is a strong contrast to Izumi's dislike of them. Also, she can be quite stingy when it comes to sharing her food. She’s also a lover of animals, as we can see when she’s with Yujirou, Sano’s dog.

He likes Mizuki, but doesn't know that she is really a girl, and some of his classmates believe that he is gay due to that fact. Nakatsu also seems to have come to terms with that fact. As Umeda says,"...he's only attracted to her feminine side," meaning that Nakatsu is responding as any teenage male would to being around a female, although it would appear he is a bit more excitable than his classmates as none of them seem to be affected by Mizuki-- or they simply hide it better. At times, he is very jealous of Sano because of how close he is to Mizuki. He entered the school with a football (soccer) scholarship, and is very good at it. Originally from Osaka (the city, which is different from the school and spelled with different kanji), he has a thick Kansai accent and frequently uses the Kansai dialect.

The guy that Mizuki Ashiya likes and an excellent high jumper. He finds out that Mizuki is a girl early in the series, but does not tell anyone else and actually becomes very protective of her secret. Before Mizuki came to Japan, Sano had been in an accident (he had tried to save his team captain from getting hit by a car, injuring his leg), causing him to quit high jumping for a while because he thought that he couldn't handle the pressure. But thanks to Mizuki's deal with her brother (Sano had to jump while her brother was in Japan, or Mizuki would have to come home), he is able to try again and was given a second chance to high jump. Sano falls in love with Mizuki, but cannot tell her because Mizuki thinks that if Sano found out her secret, she would have to leave.

The R.A. of Sano and Mizuki's dorm. He's a nephew of Umeda-sensei, and is one school-year older than Mizuki. He's a "ladies man" although very sensible. He was once in love with his tutor, Kanako Tanabe, but she left him. Umeda claims that this was what caused Nanba to become the "ladies man" he is today. In the future, it is said that he became a model. He, along with the other R.A.s finds out that Mizuki is a girl, but helps keep her secret (although it wasn't a secret for very long). Among Mizuki's group of friends, he seems to frequently butt heads with Nakatsu. He's also a former winner of the Miss Osaka pageant, during his first year at Osaka, a fact which he isn't terribly proud of. source: wikipedia

Taiki is Nakatsu's roommate, and has the ability to see ghosts and detect auras. He is always doing Nakatsu's aura report. He's also into yoga. When he first comes to Osaka High, he was teased by others due to his ESP skills. However, Nakatsu sees him as a good friend. In volume 4, Nakajo noted that Kayashima took his name from the "Kayashima Station", a railway station on the Keihan Main Line. He also claimed that many workers were injured during the construction of the station, as a large tree was considered to be cut down. The tree was later preserved, and the station was built around it. Incidentally, "Taiki" means "large tree". (Source: Wikipedia)

The most charismatic and popular "slut" of the school. There are a lot of rumors of Nanase being an uncontrollable sex queen, but in reality Nanase is a virgin and people base everything on her looks. She often uses this to her advantage when attempting to escape.

__Height:__ 139 cm (4'7") Contrary to her young and loli appearance, Hinami is a third-year student. She is very kind and has a big heart, and hates constantly being referred to as a loli or a child. She also carries a chair around with her to help her reach high places due to her small stature.

Junnosuke's sister who understands him the most. She dislikes normal men but loves her older brother and women, especially older and perverted women. Most of the time Asane is relaxed but as soon as she sees a woman who is her type, she loses control of herself completely. Her dream is to have a threesome with her brother and his girlfriend.

__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") A proud virgin who believes that there can't be sex without love. As he stays on Seiran Island and dodges the "SS" committee, he launches the "NLNS (No Love, No Sex)" campaign in order to rebel against the island's deranged laws and customs.

__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") A girl who has barely any presence and has a complex over her body, so people easily forget her. However because she was born on Seiran Island, she doesn't care about people staring at her chest during conversations.

title: 歪小子斯科特：火力全开

characters.native: ラモーナ・フラワーズ
characters.description: American expatriate who lived in New York and now works as a "Ninja delivery girl" in Canada.

characters.native: スコット・ピルグリム
characters.description: Bass player for the band *Sex Bob-Omb* with his friends [Stephen Stills](https://anilist.co/character/317372) and [Kim Pine](https://anilist.co/character/317384). Formerly dated rock star [Envy Adams](https://anilist.co/character/317368), lead singer and keyboardist for the band *The Clash at Demonhead.* He believes that smoking is evil, drinks "only on occasions", and he doesn't hit girls.

Scott's high school friend and drummer of Sex Bob-Omb. She was Scott's first girlfriend, whom he "saved" from Simon Lee. Kim has a sarcastic personality and dislikes many people. She is employed at No-Account Video throughout the series.
Chinese-Canadian high school girl and self-described "Scottaholic."
Ramona Flower's fourth evil ex. She was Ramona's university roommate and her only ex-girlfriend.

title: 最强职业不是勇者也不是贤者而是鉴定士（暂定）

characters.native: エマリア・ステインバルト
characters.description: The elf woman who helped [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/377717/Hibiki-Manabe), the protagonist who had just arrived in another world. An adventurer with the profession ‘Spiritual Archer’, she has actually never formed a party before and longs to adventure with companions.

He looks a bit young, but he's a kind, considerate 16-year-old high school student who's surprisingly brave. One day, he's suddenly transported to another world and given the job title ‘Appraiser (Provisional)’ by the god of this world, known as the ‘Chief God’.

A wolf beastman skilled with the spear. He was once a renowned warrior, but a curse weakened him. Serious and loyal to a fault, he swore allegiance to [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/377717/Hibiki-Manabe) after being saved by him, becoming his knight.

A young girl who ends up forming an adventurer's party with [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/377717/Hibiki-Manabe). She puts her all into everything she does. She possesses an immense amount of magical power that is beyond her control, but Hibiki's appraisal reveals that she is the egg of a "sage."

voiceActors.native: ラマルファ・ミッシェル・立山

characters.description: The talking white cat that appeared before [Hibiki](https://anilist.co/character/377717/Hibiki-Manabe) and the others when the skill ‘Grimoire’ was activated. Its true identity is a sacred beast created by the Demon Lord, entrusted with serving as [Lilian's](https://anilist.co/character/377720/Lilian) magic teacher and controlling her magical power. It absolutely loves to eat.

title: 领民0人开局的边境领主大人

characters.description: She is a beautiful dark-skinned woman with one blue horn. She belongs to the Oni Folk clan and has a bad attitude towards outsiders. She treats men with masculinity with favor though as they're potential husbands. Her horn can tell the true nature of someone and will attack anyone who has been deemed with red light.

The "Patriotic Hero", a man who spent 20 years of his life, fighting n a ruthless war. Now at the age of 35, he is illiterate but a kind and passionate soul who loves all people, no matter their race. He has scars covering his face and body and he's always optimistic.
Once a subordinate of Dias, after the war he remained in the kingdom and became a soldier. On the battlefield, he supported Dias in combat.

The third princess of the royal capital. Caught in a succession dispute, she discovers that the ‘hero of the national savior’ Diaz is a lord on the frontier who can secure her position, and visits him seeking his power.

The first prince of the Kingdom of Sanserife. Possessing an excellent intellect and never neglecting effort, he is the most promising candidate for the next king. He strives to purge the corruption within the country

title: 我成了S级怪兽，被误认成猫的精灵女孩骑士宠物

characters.description: A novice female adventurer. She names the kitten she found in the labyrinth "Tama" and keeps him as her pet. She aspires to be like the "Sword Saint" Alisha, who single-handedly repelled the demons that once attacked her hometown. She specializes in high-speed combat, taking advantage of her skill, "Acceleration." She has a diligent and kind-hearted personality, but when it comes to Tama, she sometimes displays hints of a rather intense fetish. (Source: Official Site)

A former human knight. He was slain by a demon's blade, but for some reason, he was reincarnated as a baby Behemoth, an S-rank monster. While on the verge of death from his grave injuries in the dungeon, he was saved by Aria, who mistook him for a kitten. He then pledges to become her knight. Even after reincarnation, his personality remains that of a proud knight. In battle, he utilizes a wealth of abilities to support Aria and the rest of his party. (Source: Official Site)

A girl of unknown origin whom Tama and Aria encounter inside the labyrinth. For some reason, she refers to Tama as the "strong one" and urges him to have her child. She lacks any kind of common sense, and Aria and the others believe she has lost her memory. But her true identity is actually...? (Source: Official Site)

A tiger-eared blacksmith who runs the "Vulcan's Armory" in Labyrinthos and is Aria's friend. She is also a C-rank adventurer, wielding a giant hammer with her innate brute strength. She has a laid-back personality, but her skills are the real deal, and she provides Aria with helpful advice. On the other hand, she can be rather shy when it comes to Tama...!? (Source: Official Site)

One of the heroes who brought victory to humanity during the “Twilight of the Demon Gods”, a huge war between demons and humans. Called the “Sword Saint” because of her ability to wield two longswords. When Aria’s village, Lumines, was attacked by the demon armies, she saved it all alone. The woman who saved Aria’s life, and the woman that Aria admires. (Source: Official Site)

title: 在异世界抚摸毛茸茸过活

characters.native: ネフェルティマ・オスフェ
characters.description: Midori Akitsu died from overwork at the age of 27 and was reincarnated in another world as Nefertima Osphe. She received the ability from God to be "liked by non-human beings".
A sky tiger. He is a holy beast who uses elemental power. He shouldn't open his heart to anyone other than his contractor, Will...
He used to be a goblin, but after meeting Neema, he evolved into a demon-like figure. He is loyal to Neema and adores her.

characters.native: ヴィルヘルト・レガ・ガシェ
characters.description: Crown Prince of Gaché Kingdom. Master of the Holy Beast, the White Tiger [Lars](https://anilist.co/character/319892/Lars).

A sacred Flame Dragon of the Fire attribute. As a traditional, long-lived being, it is capable of speech. When summoned by [Karnadia](https://anilist.co/character/322645/Karnadia-Osphe), it bestowed a Dragon Orb upon [Nefertima](https://anilist.co/character/310666/Nefertima-Osphe). Since then, it has continued to serve as a source of wisdom and a confidant for Nefertima whenever the need arises.

Koinzell is a new name taken by one of the falsely-labeled Lances of Betrayal, Ascheriit. Back in his youth he was an orphan who was accepted as a student in Ms. Gleaa's school of swordsmanship, where he accomplished such feats, especially the learning of the infamous Black Wing sword technique, that made him the new heir of the title of Blade Master, an ancient honour for those deemed true master swordsmen. He then became one of the fourteen youths chosen to carry the Emperor's spears and end the war with Wischtech, and was also one of the four to accomplish their mission, only to be betrayed and brutally murdered by their fellow companions, those who became known as the Seven Heroes. After having his left eye gouged out by Glenn, his best friend, and his body minced to pieces, he was left for dead but managed to survive by feeding on a fairy, which regenerated him at the expense of mixing his human blood with that of the faeries, thus giving him the appearance of a feminine child with pale hair and skin and red eyes. Koinzell is regarded as one of the best fighters in the series, due to not only to his swordsmanship, which include the fabled Black Wing, but also because he can create massive black chainswords from his right wrist. He is shown to be usually cold, and very brutal and ruthless when hunting down those who betrayed him, but can also be very caring, often putting himself at risk for others. That is due to that although revenge motivates him, he is still the hero which he was before being betrayed by his friends. He is empowered by the twin moons of the world, and if too fatigued he shrinks into a child fairy until recovered.

characters.native: エルサリア・ランクレーブ
characters.description: The daughter of the Imperial Elector, Aleczalt Rahnclave, and a knight of the Seven Lances. She first meets the main character, Koinzell, at the town of Jullas Abllas. It is also there that her view of the once traitor and enemy to the empire changes into something more. The Rhanclave family is one of the eight families that have the power to elect a succeeding emperor. It is also said that the Rhanclave family is over 1000 years old and specializes in fighting. She also has a strong sense of justice as her reason for joining the Seven Lances was only to protect the people and the emperor.

characters.native: アト・クシャールンド
characters.description: Ato is the third princess of the Kusharundo clan. She looks up to her brother, Kurato, and by dressing up as a boy, she could fight alongside him. After she witness Koinzell kill her brother, she couldn't accept the fact that he died and sought revenge for Kurato. She wore "The Black Dress of Vengeance" to seek revenge and tried to kill Koinzell, but eventually, she realized that Koinzell helped put Kurato out of his suffering and joined him on his quest. ~!Koinzell saves Ato's life by giving her his blood, giving her some power like his.!~ Her arsenal of weapons include a long Dual Bladed sword and various Magical Talismans. ~!Is later given a double bladed sword, crafted by Koinzell. He said her skills suited that style of weapon.!~

Peepi is a young elf girl whose village, Miruel Mirael, is slaughtered. She attempts to escape by smuggling herself to another area, though she is caught, and saved by Köinzell. Though she has the choice to join another village, she decides to stay with Köinzell. Her real name has yet to be revealed.

Altea is a smuggler who runs a tavern under. She acts tough around the patrons, though it is really just to hide her weak personality. She is a close friend of Vid, who introduces Köinzell to her. She agrees to smuggle them after Köinzell agrees to have sex with her, though the smuggling plan soon falls short. Her business is destroyed, and she decides to travel with Köinzell, especially because he reminds her of a close friend.

Mio is a first year student at Kuromi Girls 'Academy. She excels at fighting games and attends the academy at her mother's request. Mio is addicted to fighting games and doesn't hesitate to break the rules of the academy to play. She cries easily when things don't go her way, but shows strong determination when she has a goal in mind. Fellow students call her Shirayuri-sama, a nickname that infuriates her.

Aya is a first year student attending Kuromi Girls’ Academy on a scholarship. She's a skilled fighting game player and joined the academy to learn how to become a proper young lady after abandoning her hobby.

A fun-loving student who is a part of the school dorms' discipline committee, and who has loved fighting games since her early childhood. In her effort to befriend [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/223109/Mitsuki-Aya), [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/223110/Yorue-Mio), and [Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/364057/Ichinose-Tamaki), she slowly but surely gets sucked into their world.
A student who's part of the school council, which should control students and enforce the school's no-games policy, while she has a secret passion for fighting games.

An elementary school gamer with skills that rival those of professionals. She does not tolerate compromise or complacency in fighting game play, and harbors hostility toward players who only fight among friends, like [Aya](https://anilist.co/character/223109/Mitsuki-Aya) and [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/223110/Yorue-Mio). Although she frequently uses harsh language, she remains a capable competitor who stays composed during matches and handles situations calmly in pursuit of victory.

Shiki, the main protagonist of the story, is a friendly yet socially awkward boy who's the sole human denizen of the Granbell Kingdom, a fantasy theme park on the planet Granbell inhabited by robots. He possesses an ability called Ether Gear, which is inherited from the park's animatronic Demon King, granting its user powers akin to those of a machine; Shiki uses a variation known as "Satan Gravity" that allows him to alter and redirect his own personal gravity. Encouraged by his artificial family to go out and make some real friends, he gets swept up on a journey with Rebecca to see new worlds across the cosmos.

characters.native: レベッカ・ブルーガーデン
characters.description: Rebecca Bluegarden, the female protagonist, is a kind and energetic girl from the planet Blue Garden who travels to different planets to record videos of and upload to her channel on Aoneko, a video-sharing website, with the goal of obtaining one million subscribers. She pilots a spaceship called the Aqua Wing, which also functions as a seaboat. Rebecca's power, Leaper, is an Ether Gear that enhances her jumping ability, giving her great speed and agility.

Happy is a machine cat from the planet Excede, Rebecca Bluegarden's companion, and a member of the Edens Zero's crew. His ability "Happy Blasters" allows him to transform into a pair of guns that fire Ether bullets. These bullets are powerful enough to incapacitate their targets, but won't kill them. ~!Happy was a cat found by Rebecca when he was young. He instantly became friends with her due to them sharing common life events. He received his name "Happy" from Rebecca for making her happy by becoming her friend. Sometime later, an accident occurred where a drunk driver ran over Happy, which ended up killing him. Thanks to Professor Weisz, he was revived into a machine body and continued his friendship with Rebecca.!~

Homura Kougetsu is a member of the Demon King's crew on Edens Zero, and a self-described knight from Planet Blue Garden. Her power, Soul Blade, is a type of Ether Gear that allows her to create bladed weapons made of Ether.

Hermit Mio is an android who's the member of the Four Shining Stars. Her power, Master Code, is a type of Program Hacking. Hermit likes clothes and video games, and used to dislike humans, but not anymore.

title: 透明男与人类女～成为夫妻的两人～

characters.description: She is a blind, gentle human woman who works as an office worker at the "Tonome Detective Agency." She has a keen sense of hearing, smell, and touch. She is a romance novice and is flustered by Tounome's approach.

A detective at the "Tonome Detective Agency," he is an invisible, gentlemanly non-human. He can make not only his own appearance but also the clothes he is wearing completely invisible. He is attracted to Yakou.

A beastwoman investigator at the Tonome Detective Agency, primarily handling security and heavy lifting. She has a big-sister personality and is highly proactive, though she can be a bit careless at times. She nervously watches over the distance between Tonome and Yako while rooting for them.
Tonome Detective Agency investigator, a human male primarily responsible for information gathering. Appears blunt but is actually meticulous. Tsundere. Keeps romance separate from work.

characters.native: カルマ＝ダーク＝アマネセル
characters.description: A Dark Elf who runs the tea and light specialty shop “Elf Garden” with his wife, Light. He possesses the power of “curses,” and when anxious, he sometimes unknowingly curses those around him. A playful mood-maker, though he occasionally loses control...?

aliases: Yowa Yowa Sensei (よわよわ先生)
Kowa Kowa Sensei (こわこわ先生)
characters.description: A newly-appointed English teacher. Despite being considered incredibly scary by her students due to her weird behavior, she's actually incredibly weak - low stamina, a soft voice, and incredibly shy. In spite of her stigma, she wants to help her students in any way possible.

A second-year high school student who wants a peaceful school life, and who believes everything is best in moderation. He admires Hiwamura-sensei for working so hard for her students, and struggles to clear up misunderstandings between her and the rest of the class. Gets easily caught up in crazy adventures.

Abikura's classmate and close childhood friend. A "strong gal" with peak athletic ability who is at the top of the class hierarchy. She has a strong sense of justice and can't leave people who are in trouble alone. She's trusted by her friends, but she can sometimes be harsh towards Abikura.
Abikura's classmate, who is currently a truant. An aficionado of big breasts, she is a "massage type" who will try to fondle them whenever she has a chance. Foul-mouthed and cheeky.

Akihito Abikura's older sister, who works as a nurse. She's a doting big sister who constantly spoils her little brother, but with Akihito's independent personality she is trying to find another outlet for her overflowing maternal instincts.

A fire-breathing dragon with red wings who lives deep in the forest. After his biological parents died, he was raised by a mother cat. As if to repay his mother's kindness, he lives his life as a cat, snuggling up to the other cats of the forest. For certain reasons, he has an extreme dislike of humans.

A seasoned mother cat who raises her children deep in the forest. Her children call her "Mom" and she is quite courageous. She raised a cat dragon she met by chance as her own. In the past, she has also raised a magical beast's baby.
A girl attending a magic school. She has an introverted personality and lacks self-confidence. One day, she enters into a familiar pact with [Mama-nyan](https://anilist.co/character/392451/Mamanyan).
A powerful black cat dwelling deep within the forest. He proposes a plan to hunt bears to his brothers. He would later become a figure revered as a hero by the cats.
Part of the brother cats who live deep in the forest. Together with his brothers, he plans a strategy to hunt bears. He has more courage and drive than any other cat.

title: 异世界的处置依社畜而定

characters.native: アレシュ・インドラーク
characters.description: Commander of the Third Knights. Son of a marquis. A rare genius with vast magical powers and mastery of both swordplay and magic, he became the commander of the Knights at an exceptionally young age. Perhaps because he is so talented that he lacks interest in anything, he is sometimes referred to by those around him as the "Ice Prince."

A salaryman on the verge of turning 30. Before being transported to another world, he worked as an assistant manager in the accounting department. Even in the other world, his corporate slave mentality is so ingrained that he instinctively seeks work, and he can also be careless about himself. He is also an extremely efficient person.
Deputy Director of the Royal Court Magic Department. He has a strong intellectual curiosity about magic and is an excellent magician, but he often has sleepy eyes.

characters.native: ノルベルト・バラーネク
characters.description: A new recruit working in the royal accounting department. The son of a viscount. He has a cheerful personality and supports [Seiichirou](https://anilist.co/character/373708/Seiichirou-Kondou) as he adjusts to life in another world. He often struggles, caught between Seiichiro and [Aresh](https://anilist.co/character/373709/Aresh-Indolark).

characters.native: シーロ・ クエルバス
characters.description: Director of the Royal Medical Bureau. While he has a carefree demeanor, he possesses keen observation skills and sharp insight. He is an old friend of [Aresh](https://anilist.co/character/373709/Aresh-Indolark).
The heir to the headship of an oni clan that stands at the pinnacle of the ayakashi. Though always expressionless and seemingly devoid of emotion, he possesses a sublime, commanding charisma.
An ordinary high school girl. She is neglected and treated coldly at home, living each day without love or affection.
A familiar beast created from Reiya's spiritual power. It also serves as Yuzu's bodyguard.
A familiar beast created from Reiya's spiritual power. It also serves as Yuzu's bodyguard.
Yuzu's childhood friend and Tokichi's fiancée, the heir to the Nekota family.

An intelligent and righteous young girl. From a young age, Kaya understood the dangers of the dark beings residing in the far shore and will do whatever it takes to protect her family and friends. She usually maintains a stoic expression around her family and friends, but when she's fighting spectres, her demeanor shifts to one of intense bloodlust.

A dedicated and compassionate young woman, she takes her role as a kindergarten teacher to heart. She is a diligent worker who is deeply attentive to the children under her care, investing time to understand each child’s personality, preferences and dislikes.

An unknown young man. He's awkward around people, so he comes off as blunt and unapproachable, but he seems to have an unusual connection with [Mobuo](https://anilist.co/character/376715/Osamu-Mobu) and opens up to him. He appears to view [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou), who possesses spiritual abilities, as dangerous...

The mysterious old man who follows [Kaya](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou) around. He calls himself an occult writer and psychic. He's incredibly shady and looks like a dangerous stalker. He has a desperate reason for getting close to Kaya, but he's just too suspicious to not be wary of.

The seventh head of the Ebisumori family. [Mirai's](https://anilist.co/character/380245/Mirai-Satou) older sister and [Kaya's](https://anilist.co/character/348546/Kaya-Satou) aunt. A psychic with a slightly otherworldly air, she looks younger than her actual age. She had no prior contact with the Satou family, and neither Kaya nor [Shizuo](https://anilist.co/character/380246/Shizuo-Satou) had ever met her, but one day she suddenly appears before Kaya. What is her purpose?

title: 灰原君的强势青春回归

characters.description: Natsuki's unrequited love during his first round of high school. A beauty dubbed the school's idol.

A socially anxious college senior who, after constantly regretting his dull, gray high school life, is given the chance to redo it when he suddenly time leaps back seven years. He decides to take action to make sure his adolescence is rainbow-colored, but he's unaware of his high specs this time around.
Natsuki's childhood friend who supports him through his high school debut.
An energetic and cheerful girl who loves basketball. The group's mood maker.
A beautiful girl with a dignified air. Hikari's childhood friend (and guardian).

title: 女主角？圣女？不，我是万事通女仆！

aliases: Celesty McMarden (セレスティ・ マクマーデン)
characters.description: A former Japanese girl who became a maid working in the employ of House Rudleberg, utterly oblivious to her saintly role as the heroine of *The Silver Saint and the Five Oaths*.

characters.native: ルシアナ・ルトルバーグ
characters.description: Firstborn of House Rudleberg. Once an Ignoble could-have-been, now a spritely Fae Princess thanks to Melody's magic touch. Wields the mighty harisen.

characters.native: アンネマリー・ヴィクティリウム
characters.description: The foil to the heroine—villainess of *The Silver Saint and the Five Oaths*—also reincarnated and doing her damnedest to steer the world toward a happy ending.

characters.native: レクティアス・フロード
characters.description: A bodyguard knight serving Count Reginbarth. He is searching for the Count's daughter, [Melody](https://anilist.co/character/364413/Wave-Melody), guided by his silver hair and lapis-lazuli-colored eyes. Though friendly and personable, he is a man who takes things seriously. Lately, he has found himself intrigued by a maid he recently met.

characters.native: クリストファー・フォン・テオラス
characters.description: Otome cover boy and main route. Crown prince of Theolas and reincarnated soul with knowledge of future events.

A boy who tends to drift off into his own thoughts, he is the son of [Kan’ami](https://anilist.co/character/393982/Kanami), head of the Kanze troupe. Even though he’s expected to one day lead the troupe, he questions the very purpose of dance itself: “Why do people dance?” Once his curiosity or desire to explore something kicks in, he charges straight ahead without thinking, constantly dragging everyone around him into the commotion.

Inomaru’s younger sister. Though she has given up performing on stage because of her gender, she loves the world of dance and joins flute practice. Quick to get into fights, she deeply admires [Nariko](https://anilist.co/character/398683/Nariko), who is her complete opposite.

A member of the Kanze troupe and someone who truly understands Oniyasha. Because of a leg condition he’s had since childhood, he gave up on ever performing on stage, but he’s skilled at chanting and often helps Oniyasha with his practice. He’s a kind-hearted boy who cares deeply for both the Kanze troupe and Oniyasha. (Source: Official Site)

A friend of Oniyasha’s. He’s always down by the riverbank, where he and Oniyasha—who sneaks away from practice—spend their time making up ridiculous stories together. Rough around the edges but surprisingly dependable, he actually seems to have an interest in dance. (Source: Official Site)

A young performer leading the Dengaku Shinza troupe. Strict with both himself and others, he serves as the driving force behind the troupe’s morale. He also directs a sharp, critical gaze toward Oniyasha. (Source: Official Site)

title: 无自觉圣女今天也无意识地泄漏力量

characters.native: カロリーナ・サンチェス
aliases: Carolina Ruby Martinez (カロリーナ・ルビー・マルティネス)
characters.description: A young lady from a ducal family in the Kingdom of Celestia who has been scorned and labeled a failure by those around her. She harbors a sense of inferiority, often finding herself compared to her talented older sister, [Flora](https://anilist.co/character/369748/Sanchez-Flora). Though she is reserved and lacks self-confidence, she gradually begins to adopt a more positive outlook after meeting [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/369749/Ruby-Martinez-Edward).

characters.native: エドワード・ルビー・マルティネス
characters.description: The Second Prince of the Marcosias Empire and Carolina’s fiancé. Although rumored to be "barbaric" and "unrelentingly cruel," he is actually a straightforward man with a strong sense of justice, albeit a somewhat clumsy one. He is the leader of the "Blazing Phoenix Corps" and a wielder of fire magic.

characters.native: フローラ・サンチェス
characters.description: Carolina’s older sister and the daughter of a ducal family in the Kingdom of Celestia. Renowned for both her beauty and intellect, she excels in every field and is hailed as the next Saintess. For a certain reason, she regards Carolina with hostility, often hurling cruel, scornful words at her.

characters.native: マリッサ・キッシンジャー
characters.description: The third daughter of the Count Kissinger family of the Marchosias Empire. A capable woman who is cool-headed, reserved, and handles everything with effortless competence. She is reputed to be one of the most beautiful women in the empire. Having left her family for a certain reason, she comes to serve as Carolina's lady-in-waiting.

characters.native: テオドール・ガルシア
characters.description: He serves as an aide to [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/369749/Ruby-Martinez-Edward) and is the second son of a viscount's family. As the vice-commander of the "Order of the Blazing Phoenix," he is a highly capable individual possessing both genius-level magical prowess and the strategic intellect that underpins the order's operations. He is also a childhood friend of Edward, and when the situation demands it, he does not hesitate to take a firm stance with him—despite Edward's status as a prince.
Second year high school student who is a lone wolf and part of the going home club. Roommate of [Mao](https://anilist.co/character/309110/Mao-Tsuchiya)
Second year high school student in charge of photography for the movie club. Roommate of [Hisashi](https://anilist.co/character/309112/Hisashi-Ootomo)
Giichi Ichikawa is a Second year at a boy's school, and a member of the Movie Club.
First year student joining the film club. Romanticist who wants a love like in shoujo manga.
Third year student and vice president of the film club. He has a cold demeanor but is skilled with CG effects.

Ranna Himawari is a young girl with a notorious reputation as a Sukeban wielding a Bokken, often described as a "monster" for her sheer strength and brutality. She is the first main girl to fall in love under [Rokudou](https://anilist.co/character/163492/Rokudou-Tousuke)'s spell. Generally, Ranna does not speak or express much emotion other than emotional distance unless Rokudou is around, but tolerates his friends. Around Rokudou, she is extremely bubbly and smiles. She will not hesitate to stop and protect him when he is in danger, but will respect his wishes as she did not step in between Rokudou and Iinuma's fight when he asked her to and only attacked once he asked for her help. As a child, it is revealed that Ranna was adopted by an elderly couple because someone had left her at their doorstep. To their shock, even as a baby, she had a horribly demonic visage. Growing up, Ranna was nothing short of a demon for her cruel actions, even brutally dragging a priest tied to her tricycle. Thanks to special beads from the same priest, she became more demure, but reverted once they shattered. Years later, Rokudou would receive a pair of these beads, though now they completely pacify her, causing her to deeply fear them. Her surname, Himawari, means Sunflower in Japanese.

Tousuke Rokudou is physically weak and cowardly attending a school filled with delinquent students. He and his two friends live in constant fear and is regularly bullied, leading to the trio venting their frustrations in private in the school's restroom. Upon receiving a scroll from his grandfather, Rokudou gains a special pentagram mark on his forehead. Rokudou's ancestors used this spell to exorcise oni, but in the modern day, the spell causes any "bad girl" to instantly fall in love with him once he makes eye contact with them. His school life drastically changes as not only is he thrust into the delinquent culture of his school, but he encounters several girls, each one presenting a new problem. He helps rehabilitate most of the girls focused on, each one genuinely falling in love with Rokudou or becoming a close ally. While Rokudou refuses to fight in the beginning of the story, his tenacity and refusal to run away has garnered respect from his former bullies. Later, he learns kung-fu and has on learned most of its fundamentals from Ling Lan.

With the appearance and demeanor of an elementary school, Sayuri is often mistaken as one despite being a student at Aomori High. Despite her petite appearance, Sayuri is the Bancho of the school having built a reputation its strongest physical fighter. She originally targets Rokudou for his inexplicable ability to become popular with the female students of Amori High, but when she begins her attack on him, she becomes enamored with him due to his spell's power. Rokudou thus becomes her first love. Through the influence of Rokudou, she reforms and reintegrates back into school life and helps him achieve his dream of a peaceful life by means of her powerful influence over her classmates. She has since become a powerful ally of Rokudou and one of the first to jump to his aid when matters involving outside delinquents befall him or Amori.Her name, Sayuri, means Lily in Japanese.

The youngest of the Sumire Triplets (Amano, Kazeno, and Raino Sumire) and the only girl. Raino crossdresses, taking on an appearance and personality of an Ikemen and is skilled with make up. Her make-up skills are so convincing that she could effortlessly disguise Rokudou as a cute girl. She shares Rank 5 with Kazeno in the Onishima Alliance.

Iinuma was the main bully of Rokudou and his friends, subjecting them to cruel pranks at their expense. After Rokudou awakens his powers and inadvertently affected his girlfriend, Tsubaki, he challenged him to a fight. Despite being overwhelmingly stronger than him, Rokudou refused to run and took an intense beating before he asked Ranna to intervene in the fight. Impressed by his tenacity, Iinuma befriends Rokudou and becomes one of his closest allies, eventually becoming close enough to know about his power. He is one of the strongest fighters in Amori high, only behind to Ranna and Sayuri in terms of raw strength. Iinuma has a love for both ramen and motorcycles, desiring to one day own a mobile ramen stand. He loves customizing his motorcycle, but tends to make them overly gaudy and flash with unnecessary "upgrades."

The mountain god next to the Kusunoki residence. Though dignified, he loves sweets and has a capricious personality. If he uses his power too much, he can shrink. He took a liking to the Kusunoki residence's garden, which was cleared of evil spirits by [Minato's](https://anilist.co/character/374766/Minato-Kusunoki) power, and began spending time with him. His hobby is renovating gardens.

A 24-year-old man who has seen beings beyond humanity since childhood. He comes to live alone at the Kusunoki Residence as its caretaker, interacting with mountain deities, other gods, and spirit beasts. Possessing a unique ability to imbue written characters with purifying power, the strength of his talismans is extraordinary.

One of the three martens who are the servants of [Yamagami](https://anilist.co/character/375329/Yamagami). They love Western-style sweets and adore [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/374766/Minato-Kusunoki). Utsugi is innocent and mischievous.

One of the three martens who are the servants of [Yamagami](https://anilist.co/character/375329/Yamagami). They love Western-style sweets and adore [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/374766/Minato-Kusunoki). Torika is a big sister type and tomboyish.

One of the three martens who are the servants of [Yamagami](https://anilist.co/character/375329/Yamagami). They love Western-style sweets and adore [Minato](https://anilist.co/character/374766/Minato-Kusunoki). Seri is polite and well-mannered.

A replica who looks exactly like Sunao Aikawa. She is summoned whenever Sunao doesn't want to go to school and spends the day pretending to be her. Each time she is called upon, Sunao's latest memories are shared with her, though details that Sunao lacks interest in remain vague. She is serious and enjoys reading.

A second-year high school student. She created Nao as a child following a fight with a friend. Since then, whenever going to school feels like too much of a burden, she has her replica, Nao, go in her place. She doesn't like studying, sports, or school in general.
A replica who looks exactly like Shuuya Sanada. He is summoned by Shuuya to go to school in his place.

A third-year high school student and the former Student Council President whose term ended in September. She is highly popular among the underclassmen and is a well-known figure on campus, affectionately called 'Moririn-senpai' by everyone.

A childhood friend of Sunao and Nao since elementary school. After entering high school, she reunited with Nao as a senior and junior in the Literature Club. Her nickname is 'Ricchan.' She loves light novels and writes her own fiction.

title: 赛博朋克：边缘行者 第二季

characters.description: Raised in corpo towers but hardened in Maelstrom’s grip, Talia is fiercely independent and steeped in the gang’s hyper-violent, chrome-obsessed culture. (Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)
A Snake Nation netrunner with sharp technical skills and a sharper hunger for revenge, D hunts the killer who wiped out his clan. (Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

characters.native: ウィーク・キングスリー
characters.description: Once known as “King,” a veteran edgerunner at the top of his game, Weak now lives in the shadow of his former glory. (Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

Roman Carax is a young cinephile chasing real stories in a city that’s abandoned film for braindance. Obsessed with documenting truth, he shadows the lives of others — only to learn that unlike his favorite reels, Night City’s stories are messy, brutal, and rarely tied up with a clean ending. (Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site)

Project Capricorn, also known as simply Capricorn or Capri, is a personality construct created by [Kyoko](https://anilist.co/character/411116/%E3%82%AD%E3%83%A7%E3%82%A6%E3%82%B3) and the Arasaka Corporation, and is composed out of multiple, if not dozens, of digitized human psyches combined into one single psyche. Capri was put onto an Arasaka biochip, that later would be stolen from the Arasaka Industrial Park by King's Crew. After Kingsley went cyberpsycho, and the rest of the crew went AWOL, the case containing the biochip was intercepted by Kyoko.
Newly hired magical girl at Magilumiere who has an unusually good memory and a hard working personality. Her shyness made job hunting difficult until she was recruited by Magilumiere.
President and founder of the magical girl startup company Magilumiere. He is known for wearing cosplay in the office.

Engineer of magical technology employed by Magilumiere. He has extreme social anxiety, but an extreme love for magical girls as well which manifests in his concentration while working. He performs a vital support role from the office while the magical girls are in the field.
Employee of Magilumiere who handles almost all the work involving social skills such as PR, HR, and customer relations single-handedly. He's always smiling and has an agreeable personality.

Magical girl employed at AST with the precision of a calculator. She stays composed in pursuit of efficient solutions and takes pride in being the company's ace. She is uninterested in things unrelated to her mission.
